typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Recordcount as integer,
		Description as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'Select \'Distinct Member\' AS Description,count(DISTINCT MBR_ID) AS Recordcount FROM Extract.WNY_EXCLUSION_POPULATION_REPORT UNION ALL Select MBR_LOB_DESC As description,count(DISTINCT MBR_ID) AS Recordcount FROM Extract.WNY_EXCLUSION_POPULATION_REPORT GROUP BY MBR_LOB_DESC',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Description} = toString(Description),
		{Copy of Recordcount} = Recordcount) ~> DataConversion
